newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel pulled higher by gasoil futures.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel pulled higher by gasoil futures.

text.p: European jet fuel was pulled higher on Friday by firmer gas oil futures and talk of some product tightness, although activity was fairly flat, traders said.
May IPE gas oil was trading $1.50 a tonne higher at $163.75 around 1600 GMT taking a boost from firmer NYMEX heating oil.
Barge premiums were holding steady around May IPE gas oil +$18 fob ARA while cargo premiums were hovering around May IPE +$24 cif NWE.
In the Mediterranean sellers appeared relaxed and holding out for high fob quotes +$10 and more.
"We have sold some small parcels at these numbers, but larger lots could probably be secured for high fob quotes +$9," said one broker.
Libyan material was essentially sold out for April and talk has been restricted to May material at $3 or so below EU spec.
